source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines a binary two-arm fixed-schedule game, proves its equality to a scalar reduced experiment, attains it by Bernoulli(1/2) assignment and nonlinear shrinkage, and proves rho_n^*=n^{-1}-C_A n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3}).

The paper studies bounded two-arm finite-population ATE estimation and finds independent random assignment minimax under its stated estimator classes, including an unrestricted-estimator extension; it does not state a multi-arm response-alphabet Airy theorem.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3.1 replaces the original minimax problem by minimization of a quadratic expected form subject to linear constraints over assignment and linear-estimator schemes; Theorem 3.2 then gives complete randomization, a Neyman allocation, and difference-in-means in its two-arm example.

The paper studies design-unbiased finite-population total estimation over a rectangular bounded parameter space, characterizes pairwise-independent inclusion indicators, and optimizes inclusion probabilities under an expected sample-size constraint.
